newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: COLOMBIA'S COMCEL REVISES Q2 RESULTS TO NET LOSS.
newsitem.headline: COLOMBIA'S COMCEL REVISES Q2 RESULTS TO NET LOSS.

text.p: Colombian cellular phone company Comcel downwardly revised its second-quarter net income figures in a statement issued Monday.

The company, whose controlling shareholder is Bell Canada International Inc, said it made a second-quarter net loss of 1.7 billion pesos or $1.6 million, compared to the previosuly reported net income of 2.3 billion pesos or $2.2 million.
It said it made a first-half net loss of 10.4 billion pesos or $9.5 million compared to the 6.3 billion peso or $5.8 million net loss previously reported.
Comcel said the restated figures were drawn up after an "adjustment in inflation accounting".
